nodes.label: Visible Mock KRS Extraction
nodes.rationale: Phase 1–2 exposes KRS extraction as a mock so the onboarding flow can be validated before real OCR/PDF parsing exists.

nodes.label: KRS Extraction Pipeline
nodes.rationale: PDFs or images should become extracted text, normalized text, course candidates, deduplicated data, and user-verified records; GPT OSS 120B must not serve as OCR.

nodes.label: Manual KRS Entry Fallback
nodes.rationale: Extraction failure must not block the product; retry and editable manual entry remain available.

nodes.label: Deterministic Planning Architecture
nodes.rationale: Priority and scheduling are deterministic and independently testable; AI is an optional enrichment layer after study sessions are generated.

nodes.label: Hard Scheduling Constraints
nodes.rationale: Availability, class schedules, overlaps, valid planning periods, duration limits, and completed history must not be violated.
